name: Stowaway
source:
A beautiful girl with long black hair, striking dark eyes, and fair skin—and a habitual stowaway aboard the *Albatross*.

Although she insists—ironically, for a stowaway—that she absolutely will not board this particular ship, she somehow ends up sneaking onto the *Albatross* every single time.

Each time, the crew catches her, gives her a rough time, and either tosses her back onto the dock or dumps her overboard—wrapped up like a parcel—only for her to turn up on board again before anyone knows it, much to the mutual exhaustion of both her and the crew.

Though she herself denies it, she is an intensely aggressive masochist; perhaps the *Albatross*—a ship whose crew is more than happy to mistreat her—is the perfect place for her after all.

Her obsession with stowing away stems from a peculiar condition: if she stays in one place for more than seven days, she begins to lose her sanity. Consequently, a ship that is constantly on the move serves as her ideal environment.

As for why she doesn't simply buy a ticket—she doesn't have a single penny to her name.
